verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single first-party mention that USCIS publishes a section of "reports, studies, and data on various aspects on USCIS operations". That points to published operational data, but nothing shows bulk downloadable files, formats, or case and benefit statistics extracts. The Case Status and FOIA APIs are per-case transactional rails, not bulk public datasets, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented bulk dataset downloads (CSV or other extract formats), named statistical datasets such as case or processing statistics, update cadence or licensing, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the data can be retrieved without scraping.
